job.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW four-object game sprite sheet for an existing cozy animal rescue mobile game. Image 1 defines ONLY the blank canvas and four cell centers. Image 2 is the actual yard STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match gentle watercolor washes, subtle colored-pencil contours, matte paper grain INSIDE objects, spring sage greens, warm cream and muted coral. Objects must blend with a hand-painted courtyard, readable at 30 to 90 pixels. Slight three-quarter overhead view about 50 degrees unless specified. Natural believable proportions. No glossy plastic, no heavy black outline, no comic eyes unless specified.  Draw these objects at their exact positions: TOP LEFT: one small ivory bone shaped chew toy with rounded double lobes on each end; TOP RIGHT: one sky blue rubber flying disc, shallow three-quarter overhead view with cream ring; BOTTOM LEFT: one ochre yellow knotted rope dog toy, one central knot with four short frayed ends; BOTTOM RIGHT: one small mint green wooden doghouse with coral roof and a dark round entry, shallow three-quarter overhead view, no dog. Arrange exactly FOUR separate free-floating objects in TWO columns and TWO rows. Top-left at (25%,25%), top-right (75%,25%), bottom-left (25%,75%), bottom-right (75%,75%). Each object must occupy no more than 65% of its cell, fully visible with generous white margins. Everything outside the object must be perfectly plain PURE WHITE #ffffff. No ground plane, no cast shadow, no enclosing tile, no sticker border, no frame, no grid lines. No letters, captions, numbers, logos, UI or watermark. Do not include courtyard scenery or animals. Keep all four objects separate and leave the spaces between them pure white.
